subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new global `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` config knob, and must the default no-override path keep current `bootstrap-extra-files` behavior for subagent and cron sessions?
rationale: The PR adds public configuration and changes prompt/session context selection; automation can repair the compatibility defect, but only maintainers should decide the permanent config/API direction.

options.title: Additive Tier Contract
options.body: Accept the tier idea only after preserving current no-override hook-extra behavior and documenting the explicit-tier semantics.

options.title: Breaking Root-Only Default
options.body: Approve the current root-only no-override behavior as an intentional breaking default change with upgrade docs and migration guidance.

options.title: Defer The Config Surface
options.body: Pause or close the PR until a broader bootstrap/context-selection design replaces this specific global tier option.

recommendation.title: Additive Tier Contract
recommendation.body: Accept the tier idea only after preserving current no-override hook-extra behavior and documenting the explicit-tier semantics.
